content.title: Charles Schwab Earnings Miss Estimates. The Stock Is Rising Anyway.
content.summary: Charles Schwab  shares rose on Wednesday after the financial services company reported fourth-quarter earnings that slightly missed Wall Street’s expectations.  Despite that shortfall, the results showed strong growth in earnings, revenue, and net new assets, as Schwab benefited from a surge in investor activity that creates a tailwind for the company in 2026.  On Wednesday, Schwab posted adjusted fourth-quarter earnings of $1.39 per share, a penny short of the FactSet analyst consensus for $1.40.
